facts.title: japanese vegetable pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 small head cabbage, very thinly sliced (1 pound or 5 to 6 cups shreds) which will be easiest on a mandoline if you have one
4 medium carrots, peeled into ribbons with a vegetable peeler
5 lacinato kale leaves, ribs removed, leaves cut into thin ribbons
4 scallions, thinly sliced on an angle
Canola, safflower or peanut oil for frying
1 1/2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce (note: this is not vegetarian)
1 tablespoon rice cooking wine or sake
facts.author: Deb Perelman
